description: Lists identities visible to the current user in a workspace. Identities capture voice, tone, role, and audience context so AI produces work from the right perspective.

scope.description: Filter by scope: "user" for personal identities only, "workspace" for shared identities only. Omit to return all visible identities.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. If not provided, uses your default workspace.

name: list_identities
